result_summary.title: Self-Service Hub returning malformed JSON and hitting rate limits
result_summary.description: We are seeing intermittent errors with the Self-Service Hub in US-East production. The API is returning malformed JSON responses, which causes our frontend application to fail parsing the data. Additionally, some of our clients are encountering rate limit exceeded errors when trying to retry these failed requests. About 33 users are impacted, leading to a moderate business impact as they cannot complete self-service tasks. We need clarification on why the JSON structure is invalid and guidance on appropriate retry logic for rate limits.
